title: Smoked Haddock Pilaf
description: A classic Russian-inspired dish of smoked haddock, pilaf, and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked haddock fillets and cook until opaque, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the haddock from the skillet and set aside.
Add the pilaf rice to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Flake the cooked haddock into the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Stir in the zesty lemon juice, chopped fresh dill, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
